description: Deletes the questions of one webinar in one go, either all of them, only the open ones, or only the answered ones. Take it when a session fills up with test questions, for example after a rehearsal: "Clear the open questions before the real run starts." It needs the session, the webinar, which of the three sets you mean, and a clear yes from you. Look at the questions first and hear how many would go, because they are gone from the site and cannot be brought back. No email goes out. For a single question there is a separate tool. Side effect: it acts on your connected WordPress site; nothing else is touched. Words hosts use: delete all questions, clear questions, open questions, answered questions, clean up question list

confirm.description: Must be true, set only after the host said that these questions may be deleted.

scope.description: Which questions to delete: the open ones, the answered ones, or both.

session_id.description: From an earlier turn (weiter · texte · stand).

site.description: Which connected site is meant when this chat has more than one: the address exactly as wi_get_connector_status lists it under sites. Leave it out while only one site is connected.

webinar_id.description: The webinar (campaign) id, as wi_list_webinars returned it. Never invent an id.

name: wi_delete_all_webinar_questions
title: Delete a whole set of participant questions
